appraisal.note: 写作者把这条求助视为'把蓝牙通话主场立起来'的机会(高相关)；自己写出的这段答复把codec机制、ASHA无mic路径、renegotiation如何撕断链路一次性讲清，并用'pin codec+蓝牙关一次做对照'给出可执行解(促进+已满足)→正；并相信'你下次来电就会知道'，应对潜能高，所以驱动趋近+支配而非回避。

knots.evidence_quote: If it still cycles, one call sorts it out. Ring the same number with Bluetooth off, on speaker. Still cycling means it's the network leg and no hearing aid setting will touch it, which at least saves you buying something. Clean means we're back on the link and I'll keep at it with you.
